gloss: taxi en route to pick up a passenger; dispatched taxi

definitions.gloss: taxi en route to pick up a passenger; dispatched taxi
definitions.explanation: A taxi that has been called and is on its way to the customer's location. Displayed on the taxi's roof sign or meter to indicate it is not available for street hails.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{迎車|げいしゃ}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{止|と}められない→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: That taxi is on a pickup call, so we can't flag it down.

examples.japanese: {迎車|げいしゃ}⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: The dispatch fee varies by taxi company.

examples.japanese: ⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}んだら→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{迎車|げいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}した→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧。
examples.english: When I called a taxi through the app, the dispatched status immediately appeared and I felt relieved.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ (to meet/pick up) + ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (vehicle). A taxi-industry term commonly seen on taxi roof signs and meter displays in Japan. When a taxi shows {迎車|げいしゃ}, it means someone has already called it and it cannot accept other passengers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {迎車|げいしゃ}⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: dispatch fee (typically 300-500 yen)
- {迎車|げいしゃ}⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧: dispatched display (on the meter)
- {迎車|げいしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: to come as a dispatched taxi

USAGE:
Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{芸者|げいしゃ}→芸者：14149_geisha⟧ (geisha, traditional entertainer). The kanji make the meaning clear in writing, but in speech context is needed to distinguish them.
